Game Overview

Cube Jump puts players into a arcade experience centered on guide a cube through a mesmerizing neo-futuristic world, leaping across shifting platforms. Enjoy the relaxing soundtrack as you master timing in this simple yet challenging arcade adventure. With minimalist visuals and one-touch controls, Cube Jump offers endless, stress-free gameplay perfect for setting high score records.
